title: The section table

milestone.title: Ground Rules, Tools and the PE Format

description:
List a PE file's sections with their addresses and permissions.

```
name    VirtAddr  VirtSize  RawPtr  RawSize  flags
.text   0x1000    0x1A2C    0x400   0x1C00   R-X code
.rdata  0x3000    0x0E10    0x2000  0x1000   R-- data
.data   0x4000    0x0300    0x3000  0x0200   RW- data
```
hints: The name is not always zero-terminated: print it with `%.8s` (lesson 1.03).
A section that is writable and executable is unusual in normal programs and worth a closer look.
requirements: Each section header is 40 bytes: an 8-byte name, then sizes, addresses and the characteristics flags.
Decode the flags: read 0x40000000, write 0x80000000, execute 0x20000000, code 0x20.
Warn about a section that is both writable and executable.
stretch: Compute each section's entropy to spot packed or compressed data.
